problem_text:
A logistics company needs to coordinate 5 cargo shipments through 5 different ports.

Each shipment follows a predetermined route represented as pairs (Port, Handling time),
where each pair specifies the port where the cargo must be processed and the time required for handling.
The order of pairs indicates the required sequence in which the cargo must move through the ports.

Shipment details:
* S1 follows the route: (P4, 6) → (P2, 2) → (P1, 9) → (P3, 6) → (P5, 4)
* S2 follows the route: (P4, 10) → (P5, 6) → (P1, 2) → (P3, 10) → (P2, 5)
* S3 follows the route: (P2, 1) → (P4, 7) → (P5, 8) → (P1, 6) → (P3, 4)
* S4 follows the route: (P4, 1) → (P3, 8) → (P5, 5) → (P1, 1) → (P2, 9)
* S5 follows the route: (P5, 9) → (P2, 5) → (P1, 2) → (P3, 3) → (P4, 7)

Each cargo handling operation must proceed continuously once it begins and cannot be interrupted,
and each port can only process one cargo shipment at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing sequence of all cargo shipments at the ports
so that the total completion time for all shipments is minimized.
